concept: From Shed to Cup — a clean, modern roast journey where freshness, origin, and heat form one connected interface.
recommendations: Keep the monthly bean field as the single Peak while giving every section flagship craft through distinct geometry and state change.
Carry one roast-profile choice through the hero, bean recommendation, brew guidance, and subscription outcome.
Use refined motion in proof and contact sections without letting them compete with the product decision.

sections.title: Morning Roast
sections.role: Orient visitors inside a live morning batch and invite a useful roast-profile choice.
sections.inputState: The route starts with a balanced profile before the visitor chooses bright, balanced, or deep.
sections.startState: A restrained mineral field frames the freshness claim and a dormant roast subject.
sections.endState: The chosen profile changes the focal roast subject, recommendation preview, and heat signature.
sections.mechanismOwner: React shared state with coordinated GSAP geometry and type choreography.
sections.connection: Creates the roast-profile state that travels through the product, brew, and subscription regions.
sections.desktop: A large spatial selector and roast subject share the first viewport with direct shop and brew journeys.
sections.mobile: A thumb-friendly stepped selector sits below a bounded focal object with shorter, non-trapping motion.
sections.reducedMotion: Show the resolved selected profile and recommendation without scrubbed or continuous motion.
sections.evidenceTarget: #hero at load and after selecting each roast profile on desktop and mobile.
sections.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors understand the freshness promise and establish a taste preference that changes later decisions.
sections.instruction: Keep the result modern, clean, and aesthetic; motion must communicate roast state.

sections.title: Small on Purpose
sections.role: Prove the fishing-shed history, working 1962 Probat, farm relationships, and freshness economics.
sections.inputState: The hero's selected heat signature and freshness timestamp are established.
sections.startState: The story begins as a precise editorial statement with the roastery still visually distant.
sections.endState: Four business facts resolve into a traced relationship between partner farms, Bergen, batch size, and dispatch speed.
sections.mechanismOwner: GSAP route drawing, typographic compression, and measured statistic transitions.
sections.connection: Turns the hero's atmosphere into product proof and points toward the coffee origins.
sections.desktop: Oversized facts pass through a clean cartographic composition with a controlled Probat detail.
sections.mobile: The proof becomes a vertical itinerary with preserved scale changes and no horizontal dependency.
sections.reducedMotion: Display the complete route and facts in their resolved hierarchy.
sections.evidenceTarget: #story at entry, midpoint, and resolved states across desktop and mobile.
sections.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors can verify 11 farms, 2.4× commodity price, a 12kg maximum batch, and shipment in under 24 hours.
sections.instruction: Flagship craft should come from evolving evidence, not decorative spectacle.

sections.title: Find Your Roast
sections.role: Transform six coffees into an explorable recommendation field driven by the visitor's profile.
sections.inputState: Bright, balanced, or deep arrives from the shared roast-profile control.
sections.startState: All six coffees remain visible with origin, notes, roast, weight, price, and actions.
sections.endState: The field reorganizes around a concrete best match while keeping every product inspectable and purchasable.
sections.mechanismOwner: React shared state with GSAP spatial layout choreography.
sections.connection: Consumes the hero choice and sends the recommended coffee into brewing and subscription.
sections.desktop: A spatial bean field changes scale, position, image crop, and supporting data around the recommendation.
sections.mobile: A snap sequence keeps the recommendation prominent while preserving all six details and cart actions.
sections.reducedMotion: Update order and selected labels instantly without animated layout.
sections.evidenceTarget: #beans for all three profiles with all six Add to cart controls visible and working.
sections.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors receive a useful coffee recommendation and can still compare or buy any product.
sections.instruction: This remains the sole Peak and must change more than labels, color, opacity, or uniform scale.

sections.title: Brew by the Numbers
sections.role: Turn the selected roast profile into a practical and memorable pour-over sequence.
sections.inputState: The selected profile and recommended bean enter from the product Peak.
sections.startState: The complete four-step method is visible beside an unfilled brewing path.
sections.endState: The geometry resolves into a complete 18g, 300ml, 95°C, three-minute recipe adapted to the profile.
sections.mechanismOwner: GSAP scroll-authored liquid geometry with semantic DOM recipe content.
sections.connection: Converts preference into use and hands practical confidence into subscriber proof.
sections.desktop: A bounded sticky vessel changes geometry as the four textual steps advance.
sections.mobile: An inline vertical brew path uses shorter step transitions and tap-safe controls without sticky trapping.
sections.reducedMotion: Show the completed vessel and all four steps together.
sections.evidenceTarget: #brew-guide at each meaningful step on desktop, 390px, and 320px.
sections.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors can execute the full pour-over method with guidance connected to their chosen coffee preference.
sections.instruction: Use motion to teach sequence and causality, not to hide recipe content.

sections.title: Freshness, Confirmed
sections.role: Provide human proof through a high-craft but readable change of pace.
sections.inputState: The visitor has seen a recommendation and its brew consequence.
sections.startState: Three subscriber voices appear as separate dispatch fragments.
sections.endState: The fragments align into one freshness timeline spanning flavor, delivery, and gifting.
sections.mechanismOwner: GSAP typographic assembly with CSS focus and reduced-motion states.
sections.connection: Echoes the batch timestamp and shipping logic without becoming a second product Peak.
sections.desktop: Quotes assemble across a wide time axis with one controlled reading order.
sections.mobile: Quotes resolve sequentially along a compact vertical dispatch line.
sections.reducedMotion: Show the resolved reading order with the timeline already assembled.
sections.evidenceTarget: #reviews at entry and resolved states on desktop and mobile.
sections.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors understand three distinct subscriber benefits: flavor discovery, fast freshness, and gifting.
sections.instruction: Make the rest state visually exceptional while preserving calm reading.

sections.title: Your Monthly Batch
sections.role: Resolve the upstream preference into a clear two-bag subscription decision.
sections.inputState: The selected profile and recommended coffee persist from the Peak.
sections.startState: The standard two-bag, $29 monthly offer is fully legible.
sections.endState: The choice assembles a named monthly pairing and keeps the route to contact obvious.
sections.mechanismOwner: React shared state with coordinated package and type transitions.
sections.connection: Closes the same heat-state chain started in the hero and routes the visitor toward contact.
sections.desktop: Two bag forms and recommendation copy assemble into a clean decision stage.
sections.mobile: The pairing becomes a compact inline composition with the CTA in normal document flow.
sections.reducedMotion: Update the recommendation and pairing instantly without spatial movement.
sections.evidenceTarget: #subscribe after each profile selection and during CTA activation.
sections.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors receive a tailored monthly pairing while retaining the exact $29 offer and contact route.
sections.instruction: The animation must clarify the tailored pairing rather than delay the decision.

sections.title: Talk to the Roastery
sections.role: Close with a direct human channel, successful form resolution, and complete policy navigation.
sections.inputState: The visitor's profile and the current Bergen batch context reach the final section.
sections.startState: Email and message fields sit within a precise operational status composition.
sections.endState: Valid submission resolves into the one-day reply promise while the page settles into Bergen and footer details.
sections.mechanismOwner: React form state with GSAP section handoff and restrained CSS input feedback.
sections.connection: Returns the journey from machine heat to the two-person roastery and closes the freshness timeline.
sections.desktop: A split contact stage transforms into a resolved reply state beside the complete footer.
sections.mobile: A single-column form preserves large inputs, visible labels, and footer links without overflow.
sections.reducedMotion: Swap the success state instantly while retaining focus and status announcement.
sections.evidenceTarget: #contact invalid email, valid submission, success state, and #site-footer links on desktop and mobile.
sections.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors can send a valid enquiry, receive accessible feedback, and reach every required footer route.
sections.instruction: Keep the closing modern and clean even at flagship intensity.
